[Summon Ancient Fleshforged](/Spells.aspx?ID=1256)
<actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Incarnate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=388" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Lands](/Sources.aspx?ID=146) pg. 306

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [material](/Rules.aspx?ID=282), [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284)

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 250 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** until the end of your next turn
</row>

</column>

---

You summon an ancient Fleshforged, one of Nex's personal weaponized monstrosities unleashed in the first wars against Geb. It squeezes itself into its war form from time long forgotten, unleashing its wrath upon your foes. The Fleshforged occupies the space noted in the spell description. When you Cast this Spell, choose one of the Fleshforged below to summon.

- **Bone Breaker** _Size_ Gargantuan, _Speed_ 40 feet, climb 100 feet; **Arrive** _Skull Breaking Hum_ ([evocation](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1671), [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147)) The Bone Breaker appears in a shower of bone fragments. Its form is that of an immense titan of flesh and metal with long, muscular, twisted arms. The Bone Breaker releases a hum at a harmonic frequency that weakens bones in creatures' bodies. Each foe within an 80-foot emanation must attempt a Fortitude save. On a critical success, they're  unaffected; on a success, they're [enfeebled 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13) for 1 round; on a failure they're enfeebled 3 for 1 minute; and on a critical failure, they're enfeebled 4 for 10 minutes. A [skeleton](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=92) or other [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) foe made almost entirely of bones treats their result as one degree of success worse than they rolled. **Depart** _Bruising Departure_ The Bone Breaker pounds its long arms into the ground, creating a long shockwave. Each foe within a 100-foot-long, 10-foot-wide line takes 8d12 bludgeoning damage, with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save.
- **Thorn Caller** _Size_ Gargantuan, _Speed_ 100 feet; **Arrive** ([evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100)) _Thorn's Guidance_ The Thorn Caller appears in a burst of light. The Thorn Caller's body is an ornate armored sphere with black panther masks surrounding a glowing light. The ball floats in the air due to six glowing, thornlike wings. Two clusters of bird heads emerge from both sides of the body with long necks that twirl together like tentacles. The Thorn Caller's burst of light illuminates all foes within 200 feet. The foes become [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=7) and [flat-footed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=16), and if they were [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=26), they become [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4) instead. These effects last until the Thorn Caller departs. **Depart** _Thorn-Burst_ The Thorn Caller launches its thorned wings at various targets. Attempt spell attack rolls against up to 6 different targets within 300 feet. On a hit, the target takes 10d8 piercing damage, double on a critical hit, half on a failure, and none on a critical failure.
- **The Thousand** _Size_ Medium (see below), _Speed_ 30 feet; **Arrive** ([emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [enchantment](/Traits.aspx?ID=61), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=68), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) _Disconcerting Arrival_ Select five spaces in range and summon a Medium-sized polyp of The Thousand in each of these spaces. The Thousand is an entity whose full scope is 1,000 polyps of oozing flesh, each physically separate but mentally part of a single creature. Not all 1,000 polyps have survived, and the spell summons five of them. Each creature within 10 feet of any of the polyps must attempt a Will Save. On a critical success, they're unaffected; on a success, they're [frightened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19); on a failure, they're frightened 3; and on a critical failure, they're frightened 4 and [fleeing](/Conditions.aspx?ID=17) for 1 round; **Depart** ([illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=92), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) _Violent Omen_ Each frightened foe within a 60-foot emanation of any of the five polyps takes 10d8 mental damage, with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Will save.
- **Scion of Desiccation** _Size_ Gargantuan, _Speed_ 100 feet, fly 100 feet; **Arrive** ([necromancy](/Traits.aspx?ID=117), [negative](/Traits.aspx?ID=118)) _Ashes to Ashes_ The Scion of Desiccation appears in a swirl of screaming wind, a gargantuan form of twisted flesh that's constantly flensed by gritty ash and dust, and just as constantly regenerating itself. Each foe within a 40-foot emanation takes 10d10 negative energy damage, with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save; **Depart** ([necromancy](/Traits.aspx?ID=117), [negative](/Traits.aspx?ID=118)) _Dust to Dust_ Each foe within a 60-foot emanation must attempt a Fortitude save; they're [drained 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=10) on a failure or drained 4 on a critical failure.

You briefly call forth the spirit of a legendary wizard from ages long past, which manifests as an immense humanoid figure (typically an [elf](/Ancestries.aspx?ID=2) or a [human](/Ancestries.aspx?ID=6)). The archmage occupies the space of a Large creature and has a Speed of 60 feet.

 **Arrive** ([evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [force](/Traits.aspx?ID=75)) _Archmage's Amplification_ The archmage arrives in a fierce burst of magical force, automatically dealing 3d4+3 force damage to up to 5 creatures it chooses within 100 feet of it. Like [_magic missiles_](/Spells.aspx?ID=180), this can be blocked by the [_shield_](/Spells.aspx?ID=280) spell. The archmage also feeds magical power into some spells. Beneficial spells last longer due to the archmage's influence. When the remaining duration of a beneficial spell affecting you or one of your allies would decrease (usually at the start of the caster's turn), it doesn't decrease if the subject of the spell is within 100 feet of the archmage. This applies only if the spell's maximum duration was 3 rounds or longer. 

**Depart** ([abjuration](/Traits.aspx?ID=2)) _Archmage's Rebuke_ The archmage drains the magic from your foes. Each of your enemies within 100 feet of the archmage must attempt a Will save. On a failure, the creature is [stupefied 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) for 1 round, and if it's currently benefiting from any spells of a lower level than _summon archmage_, the archmage can choose any one of them and end the spell.

The herald occupies the space of a Huge creature and has a Speed of 60 feet. The effects of this spell depend on your deity's alignment.
  • **Lawful Good**: **Arrive** ([enchantment](/Traits.aspx?ID=61), [good](/Traits.aspx?ID=83), [lawful](/Traits.aspx?ID=99)) _Aura of Retribution_ While within 100 feet of the herald, you and your allies gain the champion's [Retributive Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=5) reaction; **Depart** _Holy Smite_ The herald casts 5th-level [_divine wrath_](/Spells.aspx?ID=86) (choosing good) in a 100-foot emanation.
  • **Neutral Good**: **Arrive** ([enchantment](/Traits.aspx?ID=61), [good](/Traits.aspx?ID=83)) _Aura of Redemption_ While within 100 feet of the herald, you and your allies gain the champion's [Glimpse of Redemption](/Actions.aspx?ID=6) reaction; **Depart** _Merciful Healing_ The herald casts the 3-action version of 5th-level [_heal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=148) with a radius of 100 feet. This spell targets only you and your allies.
  • **Chaotic Good**: **Arrive** ([chaotic](/Traits.aspx?ID=25), [enchantment](/Traits.aspx?ID=61), [good](/Traits.aspx?ID=83)) _Aura of Liberation_ While within 100 feet of the herald, you and your allies gain the champion's [Liberating Step](/Actions.aspx?ID=7) reaction; **Depart** _Radiating Freedom_ The herald affects you and all your allies within 100 feet with [_freedom of movement_](/Spells.aspx?ID=128). The duration is reduced to 3 rounds.
  • **Lawful Neutral**: **Arrive** ([abjuration](/Traits.aspx?ID=2), [lawful](/Traits.aspx?ID=99)) _Defy Chaos_ You and each ally within 100 feet of the herald gain resistance 20 against chaotic damage while the herald is present; **Depart** _Order's Wrath_ The herald casts 5th-level [_divine wrath_](/Spells.aspx?ID=86) (choosing lawful) in a 100-foot emanation.
  • **Neutral**: **Arrive** ([transmutation](/Traits.aspx?ID=157)) _Quickening Ripple_ You and each ally within 100 feet of the herald are [quickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=32) while the herald is present, and can use the additional action to Step, Stride, or Strike; **Depart** _Sapping Beam_ The herald casts 6th-level [_enervation_](/Spells.aspx?ID=687) in a 100-foot line.
  • **Chaotic Neutral**: **Arrive** ([abjuration](/Traits.aspx?ID=2), [chaotic](/Traits.aspx?ID=25)) _Defy Law_ You and each ally within 100 feet of the herald gain resistance 20 against lawful damage while the herald is present; **Depart** _Chaos Hammer_ The herald casts 5th-level [_divine wrath_](/Spells.aspx?ID=86) (choosing chaotic) in a 100-foot emanation.
  • **Lawful Evil**: **Arrive** _Aura of Iron_ While within 100 feet of the herald, you and your allies gain the champion's [Iron Command](/Actions.aspx?ID=552) reaction; **Depart** _Unholy Blight_ The herald casts 5th-level [_divine wrath_](/Spells.aspx?ID=86) (choosing evil) in a 100-foot emanation.
  • **Neutral Evil**: **Arrive** _Aura of Selfishness_ While within 100 feet of the herald, you and your allies gain the champion's [Selfish Shield](/Actions.aspx?ID=553) reaction; **Depart** _Infinite Despair_ The herald casts 5th-level [_crushing despair_](/Spells.aspx?ID=57) in a 100-foot cone.
  • **Chaotic Evil**: **Arrive** _Aura of Vengeance_ While within 100 feet of the herald, you and your allies gain the champion's [Destructive Vengeance](/Actions.aspx?ID=554) reaction; **Depart** _Weapon Hurricane_ The herald casts 5th-level [_weapon storm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=373) in a 100-foot cone, using d12 for the die size.
Herald Examples Each of the many deities of Golarion have their own herald; these are just a few of the most prominent.
  • **Lawful Good**: The Grand Defender ([Torag](/Deities.aspx?ID=18)), the Grim White Stag ([Erastil](/Deities.aspx?ID=6)), Hand of the Inheritor ([Iomedae](/Deities.aspx?ID=9))
  • **Neutral Good**: The Spirit of Adoration ([Shelyn](/Deities.aspx?ID=17)), Sunlord Thalachos ([Sarenrae](/Deities.aspx?ID=16))
  • **Chaotic Good**: Night Monarch ([Desna](/Deities.aspx?ID=5)), Thais ([Cayden Cailean](/Deities.aspx?ID=4))
  • **Lawful Neutral**: Lawgiver ([Abadar](/Deities.aspx?ID=1)), The Old Man ([Irori](/Deities.aspx?ID=10))
  • **Neutral**: Arcanotheign ([Nethys](/Deities.aspx?ID=12)), Personification of Fury ([Gozreh](/Deities.aspx?ID=8)), Steward of the Skein ([Pharasma](/Deities.aspx?ID=14))
  • **Chaotic Neutral**: The First Blade ([Gorum](/Deities.aspx?ID=7)), the Menotherian ([Calistria](/Deities.aspx?ID=3))
  • **Lawful Evil**: Basileus ([Asmodeus](/Deities.aspx?ID=2)), the Prince in Chains ([Zon-Kuthon](/Deities.aspx?ID=20))
  • **Neutral Evil**: Mother's Maw ([Urgathoa](/Deities.aspx?ID=19)), [the Stabbing Beast](/Monsters.aspx?ID=1007) ([Norgorber](/Deities.aspx?ID=13))
  • **Chaotic Evil**: Tarrasque ([Rovagug](/Deities.aspx?ID=15)), Yethazmari ([Lamashtu](/Deities.aspx?ID=11))

---

You momentarily summon an army of powerful dragons that unleash annihilating blasts as they descend upon your location. These dragons act as one and collectively occupy the space of a Gargantuan creature. They have a fly Speed of 100 feet. When you Cast this Spell, choose whether it summons [chromatic](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=34) or  [metallic](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=35) dragons.

 **Arrive** ([evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65)) _Energy Annihilation_ The draconic legion breathes out two blasts of energy: a 120-foot line and a 60-foot cone that can't overlap. Each creature in either of the areas takes 10d8 damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). The dragons choose the damage type of each breath weapon, depending on the category of dragons summoned. Chromatic dragons can choose cold, fire, or poison for the cone and acid or electricity for the line; metallic dragons can choose cold or fire for the cone and acid, electricity, or fire for the line.

 **Depart** _Draconic Whirlwind_ The draconic legion strikes with fury, dealing 9d8 slashing damage (basic Reflex save) to all enemy creatures in its location or within 20 feet.

**Traditions**

**Spell Lists**

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 100 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** until the end of your next turn
</row>

</column>

---

Your meditation into the different elemental planes connects you to them deeply, and this connection allows you to summon a herald of an [elemental lord](/DeityCategories.aspx?ID=8). The herald arrives in the form of a natural disaster centralized on your enemies. The herald occupies the space of a Huge creature. When you Cast this Spell, choose one of the elemental heralds below to summon; if you're a divine spellcaster who worships an elemental lord, you must choose the option matching your deity's element. This spell gains the trait ([air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5), [earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55), [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [metal](/Traits.aspx?ID=505), [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165), or [wood](/Traits.aspx?ID=508)) matching your choice.

- **Air** Speed fly 60 feet; **Arrive** ([air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5)) _Supercell Front_ The herald of air arrives in the form of a twisting tornado, with high-speed winds slamming into your enemies. Each enemy in a 100-foot emanation takes 10d8 bludgeoning damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save; **Depart** ([air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5)) _Twister Downdraft_ Each enemy in a 60-foot line must attempt a Fortitude save. A creature that fails is knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31) if it's on the ground or descends 40 feet if it's in the air. A creature that descends takes [falling damage](/Rules.aspx?ID=402) if this forced movement brings it to the ground.
- **Earth** Speed 50 feet, burrow 30 feet; **Arrive** ([earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55)) _Tectonic Rise_ The herald of earth erupts from the ground, splitting it open in a 50-foot emanation. Each enemy in the emanation takes 10d6 slashing damage from the flying debris with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save. Enemies who critically fail [fall](/Rules.aspx?ID=402) 30 feet into the crevasse, taking falling damage (the sides of the fissure require successful DC 15 [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks to [Climb](/Actions.aspx?ID=33)); **Depart** ([sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147)) _Plate Crash_ The herald of earth sinks back into the ground, and the sides of the crevasse slam together with a deafening blow, dealing 5d10 sonic damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save to all enemies in a 30-foot emanation. An enemy that critically fails is [deafened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=8) for 10 minutes.
- **Fire** Speed 60 feet, fly 40 feet; **Arrive** ([fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72)) _Magma Flow_ The herald of fire flows into the area as living magma, dealing 10d6 fire damage and 3d6 [persistent fire damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) to all enemies in a 60-foot emanation with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save; **Depart** ([fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72)) _Flame Vortex_ Each enemy in a 60-foot line takes 6d6 fire damage and 3d6 persistent fire damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save as the fire herald whips into a fire pillar before vanishing.
- **Metal** Speed 50 feet, fly 50 feet; **Arrive** ([metal](/Traits.aspx?ID=505)) _Shard Cloud_ The herald of metal arrives as a cloud of metal shards and static electricity, dealing 4d8 slashing damage and 4d12 electricity damage to all enemies in a 50-foot emanation with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save; **Depart** ([metal](/Traits.aspx?ID=505)) _Rust Mist_ The shards in the cloud rapidly rust and cling to enemies in the 50-foot emanation, dealing 10d6 damage to metal creatures and objects in the area with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save, ignoring Hardness. Unattended objects automatically critically fail this save.
- **Water** Speed 40 feet, swim 60 feet; **Arrive** ([cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27), [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165)) _Hurricane Formation_ The herald of water forms as a miniature hurricane. Each enemy in a 60-foot emanation takes 4d10 bludgeoning damage from the slamming rains and 4d10 cold damage from the falling hail with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save; **Depart** ([cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27), [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165)) _Cataclysmic Deluge_ The hurricane collapses into a rushing flood, dealing 6d8 bludgeoning damage to all enemies in a 120-foot cone with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save. A creature that fails its save is [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 20 feet away from the herald (or 40 feet on a critical failure).
- **Wood** Speed 50 feet, burrow 30 feet; **Arrive** ([plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=125), [wood](/Traits.aspx?ID=508)) _Advantageous Roots_ The herald of wood bursts forth from the ground as a complex root system. Each enemy in a 50-foot emanation takes 6d10 piercing damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save as the roots skewer its limbs and body. Each enemy that fails its save takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the herald departs; **Depart** ([plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=125), [wood](/Traits.aspx?ID=508)) _Retreat to Soil_ The roots retreat into the ground, dealing 6d10 piercing damage to each enemy in a 50-foot emanation with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save. Any creature with a penalty to Speeds from its initial save automatically takes 2d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). The ground in the emanation is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) after the roots retreat.

- **Fate** The fate stands before you with its stained-glass wings and animal-headed gaze, floating eyes circling about it; **Arrive** ([divination](/Traits.aspx?ID=47), [fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=76), [lawful](/Traits.aspx?ID=99), [prediction](/Traits.aspx?ID=132)) _Decree the Immutability of Time_ While within 30 feet of the fate, you and your allies who roll below 10 on a d20 for an attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check get a 10 instead; **Depart** ([divination](/Traits.aspx?ID=47), [misfortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=110), [prediction](/Traits.aspx?ID=132)) _Observe the Inevitability of Destiny_ Each enemy within a 30-foot emanation must attempt a Will save. If a creature fails its save, until the end of its next turn, any time it rolls above 10 on a d20 for an attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check, it  gets a 10 instead.
- **Fortune** The fortune stands before you with its golden horns and moth-scale wings, a sly smirk on its elfin face; **Arrive** ([chaotic](/Traits.aspx?ID=25), [divination](/Traits.aspx?ID=47), [fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=76), [prediction](/Traits.aspx?ID=132)) _Decree the Chaos of Infinity_ While within 30 feet of the fortune, you and your allies roll twice and take the higher roll on all damage rolls, Perception checks, and saving throws; **Depart** ([divination](/Traits.aspx?ID=47), [misfortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=110), [prediction](/Traits.aspx?ID=132)) _Sunder Eternity's Authority_ Each enemy within a 30-foot emanation must attempt a Will save. A creature that fails its save must roll twice and take the lower result on all damage rolls, Perception checks, and saving throws until the end of its next turn.

<title level="3">Iriis</title> These denizens of the [Dimension of Time](/Planes.aspx?ID=21) are powerful guardians who ward the timeline against outside meddling, even as they war with each other over their divergent philosophies of time. An irii can be either a fate, with the view that time is immutable, or a fortune, with the opinion that time is fluid. Among practitioners of temporal magic, iriis are famed for their ability to see consequences before they occur, sidestepping them at their leisure.
